turns.q: And if I change my mind, how easy is it to return?
turns.replyTail: rn?Agent saidReturns are super easy! You can return or exchange any eligible item within 30 days of purchase, and it's totally free. Just use the online returns portal—print a USPS label or get a QR code, drop your package at the post office, and your refund or exchange will be processed once it's scanned.If you're a rewards member, you might get an even longer return window. Final sale items can't be returned, but everything else is a breeze. Want the link to the returns portal or more details?
